```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Alyssa/Single_Cell_CHIP_Vascular/")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)

save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 5, height = 4, png = FALSE, svg = FALSE) {
  if (png) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".png"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  if (svg) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".svg"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".pdf"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in')
}
```


```{r}
# Set the directory containing the CSV files
dir_path = "input_data/co_culture/"

# List all CSV files in the directory
csv_files = list.files(path = dir_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

# Create an empty list to store the data frames
data_list = list()

# Loop through each file and read it into a data frame
for (file in csv_files) {
  # Extract the file name without the extension
  file_name = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  
  # Read the entire file as text
  lines <- readLines(file)
  
  # Keep the first line and lines from the fourth line onwards
  lines <- lines[c(1, 5:length(lines))]
  
  # Write the modified lines to a temporary file
  temp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
  writeLines(lines, temp_file)
  
  # Read the temporary file into a data frame
  data_frame <- read.csv(temp_file)
  
  # Add a new column with the name of the data frame
  data_frame$file_name = file_name
  
  # Store the data frame in the list with the file name as the key
  data_list[[file_name]] = data_frame
}

# Combine all data frames using rbind
combined_data = do.call(rbind, data_list)

# Split the file_name column on "_"
split_names <- strsplit(combined_data$file_name, "_")

# Create the GENOTYPE and WELL columns based on the split file_name
combined_data$GENOTYPE <- sapply(split_names, function(x) {
  if (x[1] == "DNMT3A" && x[length(x)] == "c1") {
    return("DNMT3A_controls")
  } else if (x[1] == "DNMT3A" && x[length(x)] == "c0") {
    return("DNMT3A")
  } else if (x[1] == "TET2" && x[length(x)] == "c1") {
    return("TET2_controls")
  } else if (x[1] == "TET2" && x[length(x)] == "c0") {
    return("TET2")
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
})

combined_data$WELL = sapply(split_names, function(x) {
  return(substring(x[2], 2))
})

# Convert WELL to numeric
combined_data$WELL = as.numeric(combined_data$WELL)

# Create the TREATMENT column based on the WELL values
combined_data$TREATMENT = with(combined_data, ifelse(WELL %in% 1:4, "AZD",
                                               ifelse(WELL %in% 5:8, "SAR1118",
                                               ifelse(WELL %in% c(9,12), "DMSO", NA))))

# Create the CONCENTRATION column based on the WELL values
combined_data$CONCENTRATION = factor(with(combined_data, ifelse(WELL == 1, "10uM",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 2, "5uM",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 3, "2uM",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 4, "1uM",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 5, "0.1nM",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 6, "1nM",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 7, "2nM",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 8, "5nM",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 9, "Applied to monocytes",
                                                   ifelse(WELL == 12, "Applied to endothelial cells", NA))))))))))),
                                     levels = c('0.1nM', '1nM', '2nM', '5nM', '1uM', '2uM', '5uM', '10uM', 'Applied to monocytes', 'Applied to endothelial cells'))

```

```{r}
tet2_data = combined_data %>%
  filter(GENOTYPE %in% c("TET2", "TET2_controls"))
tet2_data$GENOTYPE[tet2_data$GENOTYPE == "TET2_controls"] = "Control"
dnmt3a_data = combined_data %>%
  filter(GENOTYPE %in% c("DNMT3A", "DNMT3A_controls"))
dnmt3a_data$GENOTYPE[dnmt3a_data$GENOTYPE == "DNMT3A_controls"] = "Control"
```

```{r}
# Function to calculate DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY for each group
calculate_diff <- function(data, genotype) {
  set.seed(1234)
  chip_cells <- data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == genotype)
  control_cells <- data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control")
  
  # Ensure both data frames have the same number of rows
  n <- min(nrow(chip_cells), nrow(control_cells))
  chip_cells <- chip_cells %>% sample_n(n)
  control_cells <- control_cells %>% sample_n(n)
  
  # Calculate the difference in MEAN_VELOCITY
  diff_data <- tibble(
    DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY = control_cells$MEAN_VELOCITY - chip_cells$MEAN_VELOCITY
  )
  
  return(diff_data)
}

# Apply the function to each group and create a new data frame
tet2_diff_results <- tet2_data %>%
  group_by(TREATMENT, CONCENTRATION) %>%
  do(calculate_diff(., "TET2")) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_velocity = mean(DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY),
    se_velocity = sd(DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(TREATMENT_CONCENTRATION = factor(paste(TREATMENT, CONCENTRATION), levels = c("DMSO Applied to monocytes", "DMSO Applied to endothelial cells", "AZD 1uM", "AZD 2uM", "AZD 5uM", "AZD 10uM", "SAR1118 0.1nM", "SAR1118 1nM", "SAR1118 2nM", "SAR1118 5nM")))

tet2_diff_results$normalized_mean_velocity = ifelse(tet2_diff_results$TREATMENT == "AZD" | tet2_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes", tet2_diff_results$mean_velocity / tet2_diff_results$mean_velocity[tet2_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes"], tet2_diff_results$mean_velocity / tet2_diff_results$mean_velocity[tet2_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells"])
tet2_diff_results$normalized_se_velocity = ifelse(tet2_diff_results$TREATMENT == "AZD" | tet2_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes", tet2_diff_results$se_velocity / tet2_diff_results$mean_velocity[tet2_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes"], tet2_diff_results$se_velocity / tet2_diff_results$mean_velocity[tet2_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells"])


dnmt3a_diff_results <- dnmt3a_data %>%
  group_by(TREATMENT, CONCENTRATION) %>%
  do(calculate_diff(., "DNMT3A")) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_velocity = mean(DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY),
    se_velocity = sd(DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(TREATMENT_CONCENTRATION = factor(paste(TREATMENT, CONCENTRATION), levels = c("DMSO Applied to monocytes", "DMSO Applied to endothelial cells", "AZD 1uM", "AZD 2uM", "AZD 5uM", "AZD 10uM", "SAR1118 0.1nM", "SAR1118 1nM", "SAR1118 2nM", "SAR1118 5nM")))

dnmt3a_diff_results$normalized_mean_velocity = ifelse(dnmt3a_diff_results$TREATMENT == "AZD" | dnmt3a_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes", dnmt3a_diff_results$mean_velocity / dnmt3a_diff_results$mean_velocity[dnmt3a_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes"], dnmt3a_diff_results$mean_velocity / dnmt3a_diff_results$mean_velocity[dnmt3a_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells"])
dnmt3a_diff_results$normalized_se_velocity = ifelse(dnmt3a_diff_results$TREATMENT == "AZD" | dnmt3a_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes", dnmt3a_diff_results$se_velocity / dnmt3a_diff_results$mean_velocity[dnmt3a_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes"], dnmt3a_diff_results$se_velocity / dnmt3a_diff_results$mean_velocity[dnmt3a_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells"])
```

# Paired cells normalized statistical tests.
```{r}
# Apply the function to each group and create a new data frame
tet2_diff <- tet2_data %>%
  group_by(TREATMENT, CONCENTRATION) %>%
  do(calculate_diff(., "TET2")) %>%
  mutate(TREATMENT_CONCENTRATION = factor(paste(TREATMENT, CONCENTRATION), levels = c("DMSO Applied to monocytes", "DMSO Applied to endothelial cells", "AZD 1uM", "AZD 2uM", "AZD 5uM", "AZD 10uM", "SAR1118 0.1nM", "SAR1118 1nM", "SAR1118 2nM", "SAR1118 5nM")))

dnmt3a_diff <- dnmt3a_data %>%
  group_by(TREATMENT, CONCENTRATION) %>%
  do(calculate_diff(., "DNMT3A")) %>%
  mutate(TREATMENT_CONCENTRATION = factor(paste(TREATMENT, CONCENTRATION), levels = c("DMSO Applied to monocytes", "DMSO Applied to endothelial cells", "AZD 1uM", "AZD 2uM", "AZD 5uM", "AZD 10uM", "SAR1118 0.1nM", "SAR1118 1nM", "SAR1118 2nM", "SAR1118 5nM")))


dnmt3a_diff$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY = ifelse(dnmt3a_diff$TREATMENT == "AZD" | dnmt3a_diff$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes", dnmt3a_diff$DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY / dnmt3a_diff_results$mean_velocity[dnmt3a_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes"], dnmt3a_diff$DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY / dnmt3a_diff_results$mean_velocity[dnmt3a_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells"])

tet2_diff$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY = ifelse(tet2_diff$TREATMENT == "AZD" | tet2_diff$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes", tet2_diff$DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY / tet2_diff_results$mean_velocity[tet2_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes"], tet2_diff$DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY / tet2_diff_results$mean_velocity[tet2_diff_results$CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells"])

treatments = c("AZD", "SAR1118")

sar1118_concentrations = c("0.1nM", "1nM", "2nM", "5nM")
azd_concentrations = c("1uM", "2uM", "5uM", "10uM")


for (concentration in sar1118_concentrations) {
  tet2_sar1118_concentration_data = tet2_diff %>% filter(TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  tet2_dmso_endo_data = tet2_diff %>% filter(TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")


  print(paste("TET2", "SAR1118", concentration))
  print(t.test(tet2_sar1118_concentration_data$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY, tet2_dmso_endo_data$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY))
  
  dnmt3a_sar1118_concentration_data = dnmt3a_diff %>% filter(TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  dnmt3a_dmso_endo_data = dnmt3a_diff %>% filter(TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")

  print(paste("DNMT3A", "SAR1118", concentration))
  print(t.test(dnmt3a_sar1118_concentration_data$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY, dnmt3a_dmso_endo_data$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY))
}
for (concentration in azd_concentrations) {
  tet2_azd_concentration_data = tet2_diff %>% filter(TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  tet2_dmso_mono_data = tet2_diff %>% filter(TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")

  print(paste("TET2", "AZD", concentration))
  print(t.test(tet2_azd_concentration_data$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY, tet2_dmso_mono_data$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY))
  
  dnmt3a_azd_concentration_data = dnmt3a_diff %>% filter(TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  dnmt3a_dmso_mono_data = dnmt3a_diff %>% filter(TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")

  print(paste("DNMT3A", "AZD", concentration))
  print(t.test(dnmt3a_azd_concentration_data$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY, dnmt3a_dmso_mono_data$normalized_DIFF_MEAN_VELOCITY))
}
```

# Normalized statistical tests.
```{r}
dnmt3a_control_dmso_endos = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")
tet2_control_dmso_endos = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")
dnmt3a_control_dmso_monos = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")
tet2_control_dmso_monos = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")

dnmt3a_dmso_endos = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "DNMT3A", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")
tet2_dmso_endos = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "TET2", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")
dnmt3a_dmso_monos = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "DNMT3A", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")
tet2_dmso_monos = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "TET2", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")

print("DNMT3A vs control DMSO applied to endothelial cells")
print(t.test(dnmt3a_dmso_endos$normalized_mean_velocity, dnmt3a_control_dmso_endos$normalized_mean_velocity))
print("DNMT3A vs control DMSO applied to monocytes")
print(t.test(dnmt3a_dmso_monos$normalized_mean_velocity, dnmt3a_control_dmso_monos$normalized_mean_velocity))
print("TET2 vs control DMSO applied to endothelial cells")
print(t.test(tet2_dmso_endos$normalized_mean_velocity, tet2_control_dmso_endos$normalized_mean_velocity))
print("TET2 vs control DMSO applied to monocytes")
print(t.test(tet2_dmso_monos$normalized_mean_velocity, tet2_control_dmso_monos$normalized_mean_velocity))

sar1118_concentrations = c("0.1nM", "1nM", "2nM")
azd_concentrations = c("1uM", "2uM", "5uM", "10uM")


for (concentration in sar1118_concentrations) {
  dnmt3a_sar1118 = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "DNMT3A", TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  dnmt3a_control_sar1118 = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  dnmt3a_dmso = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "DNMT3A", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")
  
  print(paste("DNMT3A vs control SAR1118", concentration))
  print(t.test(dnmt3a_sar1118$normalized_mean_velocity, dnmt3a_control_sar1118$normalized_mean_velocity))
  print(paste("DNMT3A SAR1118", concentration, "vs DMSO"))
  print(t.test(dnmt3a_sar1118$normalized_mean_velocity, dnmt3a_dmso$normalized_mean_velocity))

  tet2_sar1118 = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "TET2", TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  tet2_control_sar1118 = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  tet2_dmso = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "TET2", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")
  
  print(paste("TET2 vs control SAR1118", concentration))
  print(t.test(tet2_sar1118$normalized_mean_velocity, tet2_control_sar1118$normalized_mean_velocity))
  print(paste("TET2 SAR1118", concentration, "vs DMSO"))
  print(t.test(tet2_sar1118$normalized_mean_velocity, tet2_dmso$normalized_mean_velocity))

}
for (concentration in azd_concentrations) {
  dnmt3a_azd = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "DNMT3A", TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  dnmt3a_control_azd = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  dnmt3a_dmso = dnmt3a_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "DNMT3A", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")
  
  print(paste("DNMT3A vs control AZD", concentration))
  print(t.test(dnmt3a_azd$normalized_mean_velocity, dnmt3a_control_azd$normalized_mean_velocity))
  print(paste("DNMT3A AZD", concentration, "vs DMSO"))
  print(t.test(dnmt3a_azd$normalized_mean_velocity, dnmt3a_dmso$normalized_mean_velocity))

  tet2_azd = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "TET2", TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  tet2_control_azd = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
  tet2_dmso = tet2_normalized_results %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "TET2", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")
  
  print(paste("TET2 vs control AZD", concentration))
  print(t.test(tet2_azd$normalized_mean_velocity, tet2_control_azd$normalized_mean_velocity))

}
```

# Drug statistical tests.
```{r}
genotypes = c("TET2", "DNMT3A")

sar1118_concentrations = c("0.1nM", "1nM", "2nM", "5nM")
azd_concentrations = c("1uM", "2uM", "5uM", "10uM")

for (genotype in genotypes) {
  for (concentration in sar1118_concentrations) {
    sar1118 = combined_data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == genotype, TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
    dmso_endos = combined_data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == genotype, TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "to endothelial cells")
    
    print(paste(genotype, "SAR1118", concentration))
    print(t.test(sar1118$MEAN_VELOCITY, dmso_endos$MEAN_VELOCITY))
  }
  for (concentration in azd_concentrations) {
    azd = combined_data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == genotype, TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
    dmso_monos = combined_data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == genotype, TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "to monocytes")
      
    print(paste(genotype, "AZD", concentration))
    print(t.test(azd$MEAN_VELOCITY, dmso_monos$MEAN_VELOCITY))
  }
}
```

# Evaluate rescue.
```{r}
azd_10uM_tet2_monos = tet2_data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "TET2", TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == "2uM")
dmso_tet2_control_monos = tet2_data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")
sar_1nM_dnmt3a_monos = dnmt3a_data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "DNMT3A", TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == "1nM")
dmso_dnmt3a_control_monos = dnmt3a_data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")

print("AZD TET2 rescue")
print(t.test(azd_10uM_tet2_monos$MEAN_VELOCITY, dmso_tet2_control_monos$MEAN_VELOCITY))
print("SAR DNMT3A rescue")
print(t.test(sar_1nM_dnmt3a_monos$MEAN_VELOCITY, dmso_dnmt3a_control_monos$MEAN_VELOCITY))






check_significance = function(genotype, data) {
  sar1118_concentrations = c("0.1nM", "1nM", "2nM", "5nM")
  azd_concentrations = c("1uM", "2uM", "5uM", "10uM")

  for (concentration in sar1118_concentrations) {
    sar1118 = data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == genotype, TREATMENT == "SAR1118", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
    control_endos = data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to endothelial cells")
    
    print(paste(genotype, "SAR1118", concentration))
    print(t.test(sar1118$MEAN_VELOCITY, control_endos$MEAN_VELOCITY))
  }
  for (concentration in azd_concentrations) {
    azd = data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == genotype, TREATMENT == "AZD", CONCENTRATION == concentration)
    control_monos = data %>% filter(GENOTYPE == "Control", TREATMENT == "DMSO", CONCENTRATION == "Applied to monocytes")
      
    print(paste(genotype, "AZD", concentration))
    print(t.test(azd$MEAN_VELOCITY, control_monos$MEAN_VELOCITY))
  }
}


check_significance("TET2", tet2_data)
check_significance("DNMT3A", dnmt3a_data)
```
